earnings.title: WESCO International, Inc. / 225 West Station Square Drive, Suite 700 / Pittsburgh, PA 15219
highlights: Record third quarter reported net sales of $7.2 billion, up 17% YOY and up 8% sequentially
Data center sales of $1.8 billion, up ~55% YOY
Record total company backlog, up ~ 80% YOY

quotes.text: We are very pleased with our record third quarter results and carry positive business momentum into the fourth quarter. Once again, sales, backlog, operating profit, and earnings per share all increased double digits versus the prior year and achieved records that exceeded our expectations.
quotes.by: John Engel, Chairman, President, and CEO

items.heading: Adverse conditions in the global economy and disruptions of financial and commodities markets could negatively impact us and our customers.

Volatile trade policies, including a shift toward a “reciprocal” tariff regime in the U.S., and retaliatory measures by foreign governments, could materially increase our costs, disrupt supply availability and lead times, reduce price competitiveness, and adversely affect demand for our products and services.
Our global operations expose us to political, economic, legal, currency and other risks.
We are subject to various laws and regulations globally and any failure to comply could adversely affect our business.

Expansion into new business activities, industries, product lines, services offerings, or geographic areas could subject the Company to increased costs and risks and may not achieve the intended results.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Strategic Initiatives and Acquisitions

items.heading: Our strategic and operational initiatives, including our business transformation enabled by digital initiatives, are subject to various risks and uncertainties, and we may be unable to implement the initiatives successfully.
